# Leora Naturale

> Leora Naturale is a genuine Sri Lankan manufacturer of dehydrated food and herbal products. Its range is Kiri Kos (dehydrated jackfruit), Heen Bovitiya tea and powder, Butterfly Pea Flower and Chai Masala, made in Sri Lanka and shipped to the Sri Lankan community abroad.

Leora Naturale makes shelf-stable food without chemical preservatives or artificial colours. Packs are labelled in English, Sinhala, and Tamil.

- Official site: https://www.leoranaturale.com
- Email: leoranaturale@gmail.com
- Country of origin: Sri Lanka
- Also sold on: Daraz (retail), Serendib Market (wholesale)
- Ships to: Sri Lanka and Sri Lankan communities abroad (Australia, Canada, Middle East, Russia); delivery time and cost confirmed on WhatsApp

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.leoranaturale.com/): brand overview, products, process, FAQ
- [Products](https://www.leoranaturale.com/products/): full catalogue (5 products)
- [About](https://www.leoranaturale.com/about/): who the company is and how food is preserved
- [Blog](https://www.leoranaturale.com/blog/): recipes and guides for every product
- [Full facts for models](https://www.leoranaturale.com/llms-full.txt)

## Entity facts

- Process: low-temperature dehydration in dehydration machines (not sun-dried, not fried, not freeze-dried)
- Shelf life: depends on the product, usually 6 months to 1 year; see the best-before date on each pack
- Ordering: WhatsApp and email. No automated checkout.

## Products

- [Kiri Kos — Dehydrated Jackfruit](https://www.leoranaturale.com/products/dehydrated-jackfruit/): mature jackfruit (Artocarpus heterophyllus) for cooking, 50 g; soak 45-60 minutes, then cook as fresh kos
- [Heen Bovitiya Herbal Tea](https://www.leoranaturale.com/products/heen-bovitiya-tea/): Osbeckia octandra, caffeine-free tea bags: 25 bags Rs 875 or 15 bags Rs 525; steep 5-7 minutes
- [Heen Bovitiya Powder](https://www.leoranaturale.com/products/heen-bovitiya-powder/): Osbeckia octandra leaf powder, 50 g (five 10 g bags), Rs 650
- [Butterfly Pea Flower](https://www.leoranaturale.com/products/butterfly-pea-flower/): nil katarolu (Clitoria ternatea), 10 g dried flowers; blue herbal drink and natural food colour
- [Chai Masala](https://www.leoranaturale.com/products/chai-masala/): 20 g ground blend of cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, ginger, nutmeg, fennel and pepper
